items.title: General Motors (GM) Extends China Joint Venture For 20 More Years
items.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) and SAIC Motor renewed their China joint venture for another 20 years, with a focus on new energy vehicles and global exports. The partners plan to launch at least 30 new energy vehicle models and build out GM's premium Electra sub brand from China. The renewed agreement shifts GM's China role toward local R&D, two way technology sharing, and positioning China as an export hub for next generation EVs.
